learned_correction.title: Rollout verification and deployed-version checks
learned_correction.summary: For rollout events, always compare the currently deployed version with the version the plan will deploy and provide a short summary of what changed and will be deployed. Check infrastructure health before rollout, then application health after apply finishes and again 30 minutes later. On 13 October 2026, the requester reiterated that before/after versions and deployment changes must be reported. They asked for persistent investigation when container inspection is unavailable, suggesting the last successful Terraform apply, a version file or boot logs as alternative sources. Which alternative reliably identifies the deployed container version remains open.

Tenant identities, resources, run IDs and source revisions are pseudonyms; timestamps and internal UUIDs survive. Routing custody IDs are omitted.
